title: Page 194
transc:
Horner NY  Washn Oct 5th 1864
Hannah plaster for Belcher care Tappan Vain fleet
unity Wreathe recd Shelter Rucker has succeeded in
getting sufficient vessels from Hampton wileys & Bergen
to answer the purpose required Those from Frog
need not be sent walrus Geo D Wise


SH Beckwith  Wash Oct 5th 64
Henrietta Caldwell Bellows tulip Warps in this morning
from Chester state Kindle had sutton Hurly with
Dayton Sprague skimmer besides Trades queen and Rosser
Palmyra of Pedlar yard all new widows rank
pack as rapidly swee could get them out
talbot hands talbot state authorities There hasben no
neglect on this trinity wiley Lady in long
cipher from Geneva to follow Randall Baker lives
